'''Black_wraith My favorite decoration''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Black_wraith]]
* '''Published:''' 12 November 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber|CC-D-cloudcitycarbonitechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Cloud City Carbonite Chamber Blac Myfavori.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

just another carbon deck, but it needs some advice. im taking to a local tournament this weekend so if you could help, the sooner the better.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

The stratagy is to play iggy and use his text to pull from force pile what ever you need, get jabba's prize to the audeince chamber, flip, play Dark Deal, drain. simple really.

sorry about the ito/greedo mix up, they were suppused to be virtual, up i mess up.
